facts.business: Silver Oak (India) Limited is engaged in the distillery and alcohol manufacturing business, subject to statutory, regulatory, excise, and environmental requirements.

auditor.name: Not stated in the provided excerpts
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Emphasis of Matters: (A) Outstanding trade payables aged three years or older remain unpaid, raising uncertainties regarding settlement and impacting financial position and liquidity. (B) Physical verification of inventory not conducted at reasonable intervals as inventories are held under custody of Excise Department since licence was not renewed by the Company.

key_risks: Fluctuation in availability and prices of raw materials (molasses, grains) depending on agricultural production and market dynamics
Energy and input cost volatility influencing economics of distillery operations
Comprehensive regulatory framework including excise regulations, environmental requirements, pollution control norms, licensing requirements varying across States
Aged trade payables (three years or older) remaining unpaid, raising uncertainties regarding settlement and impacting liquidity
Inventory held under custody of Excise Department as licence was not renewed, preventing physical verification
Continued absence of revenue from operations leading to accumulation of losses and erosion of net worth
Current liabilities significantly higher than current assets (Current Ratio 0.05)
Negative net worth and debt-equity ratio (-0.99) due to progressive erosion from administrative losses
